categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the electronic chemicals sector, focusing on the research, production, and sales of photoresists and coatings. Key product lines include PCB photoresists, display photoresists, photovoltaic (PV) photoresists, and various specialized coatings such as 3C consumer electronics coatings, automotive coatings, heavy-duty anti-corrosion coatings, functional membrane coatings, and metal packaging coatings. The company also develops new materials for emerging applications like photovoltaic cells and industrial protection.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced photolithography and UV curing technologies for its photoresists and coatings. Production processes include precise resin formulation, dispersion, grinding, filtration, and packaging, supported by PLC control systems for quality and efficiency. It has proprietary technologies in liquid photoetching inks, LDI (Laser Direct Imaging) compatible inks, and graphene-modified anti-corrosion coatings. The company emphasizes environmentally friendly production methods, including solventless, waterborne, and UV-curable coatings.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in the PCB, flat panel display, photovoltaic, 3C consumer electronics, automotive, metal food packaging, and industrial heavy anti-corrosion sectors. Major end markets are domestic Chinese electronics manufacturers, automotive OEMs (including new energy vehicles), solar cell producers, and packaging companies. The company serves well-known brands in smartphones, smart wearables, automotive parts, and cosmetics packaging.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with production bases in Jiangsu, Hunan, Guangdong, and Jiangxi provinces. It has significant market presence in the Yangtze River Delta and Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, which are major electronics industry clusters. The company also exports a small portion of its products internationally, including to Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of specialized electronic chemical materials and coatings. It produces key materials used by downstream manufacturers of PCBs, displays, photovoltaic cells, and consumer electronics. It also integrates upstream by producing some resin raw materials internally to reduce costs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening R&D in high-performance, environmentally friendly photoresists and coatings, expanding into photovoltaic materials, and developing graphene-based heavy-duty anti-corrosion coatings. The company focuses on innovation to meet evolving customer needs for higher precision, durability, and sustainability. It invests in new production capacity, especially in the Jiangxi Longnan base, and emphasizes product upgrades, cost reduction, and market expansion in emerging sectors like new energy vehicles and solar PV.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of photoresists, coatings, and related chemical materials to industrial customers. The company uses an order-based production model combined with safety stock to meet customer demand. Sales are mostly domestic with some export sales. It also earns investment income from financial assets and occasionally from asset disposals.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic manufacturer in PCB photoresists and 3C consumer electronics coatings, competing against international giants like AkzoNobel, PPG, BASF, and Nippon Paint in coatings. It holds a strong position in China’s PCB photoresist market and is expanding in display and photovoltaic photoresists. In coatings, it is recognized as a top domestic player with growing market share in automotive and industrial anti-corrosion segments, successfully achieving import substitution in several product lines.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 518 million, a slight increase of 1.63% over the previous year. However, it recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 32 million, impacted by goodwill impairment and credit losses. Total assets were about RMB 1.18 billion with equity of RMB 752 million. The company is investing heavily in capacity expansion and R&D, with a focus on long-term growth despite short-term profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-performance, environmentally friendly electronic chemical materials that meet stringent quality and precision requirements for advanced electronics manufacturing. Its products offer superior durability, precision, and environmental compliance, including low VOC and solventless formulations. The company leverages proprietary technologies and close customer collaboration to provide customized solutions that enhance product quality, reduce costs, and support sustainable development. Its integration of graphene in anti-corrosion coatings and early entry into photovoltaic materials provide competitive differentiation.
